name: python-image-preview
description: Preview arrays, tensors and figures while debugging: NumPy, Pillow, OpenCV, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly, pandas, TensorFlow, PyTorch, JAX, CuPy, SimpleITK, nibabel, Bokeh, Altair

pythonImagePreview.keepHistory.markdownDescription: Write every preview to a new file (`name-HHMMSS-mmm.png`) so each one opens in its own tab and earlier previews stay open for comparison. When off, a variable always reuses the same file.

pythonImagePreview.cacheDirectory.markdownDescription: Directory where preview images are written. Leave empty to use a folder under the OS temp directory. Supports `${workspaceFolder}`, `${workspaceFolderBasename}`, `${fileDirname}`, `${fileBasenameNoExtension}`, `${userHome}`, `${tmpdir}` and `${env:NAME}`. The debugged Python process must be able to write here.

pythonImagePreview.clearOnSessionEnd.description: Delete preview images when the debug session ends.

pythonImagePreview.openBeside.description: Open the preview in a column beside the editor instead of the active column.

pythonImagePreview.hoverPreview.markdownDescription: Show a thumbnail and the shape/dtype of an image-like variable when hovering it while the debugger is paused. VS Code shows the debugger's own hover first; hold `Alt` (`Option` on macOS) while hovering to see this one. The thumbnail is rendered in the debugged process the first time a variable is hovered at a given stop.

pythonImagePreview.hoverThumbnailWidth.description: Maximum width in pixels of the thumbnail shown in the hover. The image is scaled down to fit both limits, keeping its aspect ratio.

pythonImagePreview.hoverThumbnailHeight.description: Maximum height in pixels of the thumbnail shown in the hover. Keep it small enough for the hover to show without scrolling; when hovering a variable name with Alt, other extensions' hovers (e.g. Pylance) share the same popup.

pythonImagePreview.inlineThumbnails.markdownDescription: While paused, show a small thumbnail right before each visible mention of an image-like local variable. Hover the thumbnail for a larger preview and the renderer links. Thumbnails are rendered in the debugged process once per stop and variable.

pythonImagePreview.inlineThumbnailHeight.markdownDescription: Height in pixels of the inline thumbnail. `0` follows the editor line height (from `#editor.lineHeight#` or `#editor.fontSize#`). Larger values make neighbouring lines overlap.

pythonImagePreview.inlineThumbnailLimit.description: Maximum number of variables rendered as inline thumbnails per stop, nearest to the paused line first. Lower it if stepping feels slow in functions with many large images.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Show `img: (480, 640, 3) uint8` for image-like local variables only. Other variables show no inline value.
Image-like variables show their shape and dtype; every other variable shows its value as VS Code normally does.
Leave inline values entirely to VS Code.
pythonImagePreview.inlineValues.markdownDescription: What to show at the end of lines while paused (requires `#debug.inlineValues#` to be `auto` or `on`).

pythonImagePreview.grayscaleColormap.markdownDescription: Matplotlib colormap applied when a 2-D (single-channel) array is rendered with the Matplotlib renderer, e.g. `gray`, `viridis`, `magma`. Color arrays are not affected.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.mjs
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.mjs --production
